name: himvedicherbals
description: Trishanku Baba - Premium organic gau products, bio-fertilizers, and medicinal herbs from Nepal

scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev dist --local --d1 BLOG_DB=blog-db-local --d1 USERS_DB=users-db-local --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=himvedicherbals
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=himvedicherbals --branch=preview
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate:blog && npm run db:migrate:users
